title: Neutralisation
summary: Acid + base → salt + water. How neutralisation cures indigestion, soothes ant bites, fixes soil and treats factory waste, plus your first titration.

ib.note: Titration technique developed further in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: Exploring Substances (neutralisation in everyday life)
Ch 2: Acids, Bases and Salts (reaction of acids with bases)

objectives: I can write the general word equation for neutralisation.
I can explain everyday uses of neutralisation.
I can carry out a (virtual) titration and explain the sharp pH change at the end point.
I can explain why neutralisation is exothermic.
misconceptions: Neutralisation always gives exactly pH 7 no matter how much base is added.
Mixing an acid and base makes them disappear.
